title: Kelvin API Problem Details
description: RFC 7807/9457 Problem Details envelope for every non-2xx response from the Kelvin control plane. Serialized as application/problem+json. Normative reference: docs/api/API_STANDARDS.md §7.

type.description: Stable URN identifying the problem type from the registry in docs/api/API_STANDARDS.md §7.2. Clients MUST treat this value as an opaque string and MUST NOT branch on title or detail.

title.description: Human-readable summary of the problem type. Stable across occurrences of the same type; MUST NOT contain dynamic request data.

status.description: HTTP status code; MUST match the status line of the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. MUST be sanitized: no stack traces, SQL, table/column names, file paths, internal hostnames, or third-party exception text. See API_STANDARDS.md §7.3.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this specific occurrence, typically the request path.

correlation_id.description: The X-Correlation-ID of the failing request. Required on every error response; the sole cross-trust-boundary diagnostic handle.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when the problem was produced.

errors.description: Field-level validation failures. MUST be present on urn:kelvin:problem:validation_failed (422) and MUST be absent on all other problem types.

field.description: Dotted path to the invalid field with zero-based array indices, e.g. targets[0].host.

code.description: Stable snake_case machine-readable error code; safe for client branching.

message.description: Human-readable, English, sanitized message for this field.

allowed_values.description: Optional allow-list of valid values for enum/range rejections.

retry_after_seconds.description: Mirrors the Retry-After header. Present on 429 and 503 problems.
